chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from a man, from Al-Mandil ibn Ali al-Anzi, from Muhammad ibn Mutrif, from Al-Masma', from Al-Asbagh ibn Nabata, from Imam Ali (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

When the Honorable, the Exalted God becomes angry with a nation and does not send down punishment upon them, their prices become inflated, their lifespans shorten, their trade yields no profit, their fruits do not grow well, their rivers do not flow abundantly, rain is withheld from them, and the wicked among them are given power over them.

key_terms.شِرَارُهَا: The wicked / worst of the people

ai.seo_question: What are the seven signs of God's anger upon a nation before He destroys them?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, this hadith details the 'seven calamities' (al-masa'ib al-sab') that serve as divine warnings before total destruction, emphasizing that economic and natural distresses are often precursors to spiritual reckoning. The narration links material decline—such as inflated prices and shortened lifespans—to the rise of the 'worst of people' (shiraruhum) in leadership, a theme frequently discussed in Shia exegetical traditions regarding societal decay. This serves as a practical indicator for believers to engage in repentance (tawbah) and self-reflection when observing these signs in the community.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 7-49 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Al-Abbas ibn Ma’ruf, on the authority of someone, on the authority of Mandel ibn Ali al-Enzi, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Motrif, on the authority of Mosma’, on the authority of Al-Asbaq ibn al-Nobatat, on the authority of the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “

If the Honorable the Exalted God becomes angry with a nation and doesn’t destroy them, He will bring about inflation; shorten their lives; bring loss to their trade; reduce the amount of fruit grown on their trees; reduce the amount of water flowing in their streams; withhold rain from them; and the wicked ones will overcome them.”
